comment: Declared HS 293329 is only partially correct. It covers the nitrogen-heterocycle iodine derivatives (povidone iodine, hydantoin, imidazolium/pyridinium iodides, iodopyridines) - a real but minority slice of the range. The bulk of the catalogue is inorganic iodine and iodides (HS 2811.19), iodinated aromatic hydrocarbons (2903), iodo/iodoxy benzoic acids (2904), iodophenols (2908), iodoanilines (2921), iodo-alcohols/carbamates (2922) and organo-sulphur iodine compounds (2930). Industry label 'Нефтегаз и химия' is a misclassification: this is a pharma/fine-chemical iodine-derivative maker (pharma, nutraceutical, agrochem, animal care, electronics, radiography), not oil & gas. No trader signs: own manufacturing facility, GMP/ISO certifications, R&D, CRAMS. Product lines missing from the declaration: elemental iodine and inorganic iodides (potassium/sodium/ammonium/zinc iodide, potassium iodate), iodo-aromatic hydrocarbons, IBX/iodoxy acids, IPBC biocide, iodoform/thymol iodide/pralidoxime iodide APIs, and possible iodinated contrast media. Per rule 3 the HS mismatch is not a rejection ground - company retained, code corrected to the actual multi-code basket above. All product lines are taken from the company's own website catalogue (infiniumpharmachem.com, Products A-to-Z and Featured APIs); no customs line was available to me in this task, so the specific export HS lines remain 'заявлено, не подтверждено' - the product range itself is documented on the site, shipment-level HS confirmation is not.
